outcome: need for bubble continuous positive airway pressure
persistent pulmonary hypertension of the newborn
cohort: All inborn neonates with meconium aspiration syndrome at the University Hospital of the West Indies over a 5-year period
finding: The incidence of meconium aspiration syndrome was 10 per 1,000 live births, and the disease spectrum was milder with lower morbidity and mortality compared to other resource-limited settings.
mod_finding: 32% of neonates were delivered by emergency cesarean section.
